name: Gris: Deluxe Edition
storyline: Gris is a hopeful young girl lost in her own world, dealing with a painful experience in her life. Her journey through sorrow is manifested in her dress, which grants new abilities to better navigate her faded reality. As the story unfolds, Gris will grow emotionally and see her world in a different way, revealing new paths to explore using her new abilities.
summary:
GRIS Devolver Deluxe Edition Contents:
• Physical Nintendo Switch or PlayStation 5 game
• 100+ page artbook
• Official soundtrack CD
• Collectible box

GRIS is a narrative-driven platformer about a young girl processing emotional pain. As she journeys through a stylized world, her dress grants new abilities that help her navigate and understand her experience. The game offers a peaceful, artistic exploration with light puzzles and platforming, designed to be accessible to all players regardless of language. The experience focuses on emotional growth and discovery without traditional game challenges like death or frustration.
